title: The generic Snakemake path and the demonstration it runs
note: Section 28: the default target is the generic harness, it runs the end-to-end demonstration, and the demonstration's exit status is its judge's verdict.

mutations.name: WG1_the_default_target_skips_the_demonstration
mutations.rationale: the generic workflow's default target runs no proposal-to-decision path

mutations.name: WG2_the_demo_workspace_is_undeclared
mutations.rationale: the demonstration writes a workspace Snakemake does not know about, so a rerun mixes two runs' records

mutations.name: WG3_the_demonstration_always_succeeds
mutations.rationale: a demonstration whose judge refused it passes the Snakemake target

mutations.name: WG4_a_raising_demonstration_succeeds
mutations.rationale: a required runtime that is missing reads as a successful demonstration
